snippet.title: Nodus Fall - World Premiere Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Nodus Fall is a brand new game from Hoyoverse. Set in a world beset by chaos and haunted by ancient hatreds, Nodus Fall is an original co-op action game where players take on the role of a Weaver and use divine power to conquer mythical beasts. 

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom
